reviews.title: Greatest Messaging App
reviews.pros:
Security. Telegram is far more secure than any other messaging app out there.

Design. Minimalistic and straightforward, exactly what you want from a messaging app.

Price. Most important features are free.
reviews.cons: Not really popular yet. Many people still use WhatsApp only (mistake).
reviews.overall: A great messaging app. If you're looking for a secure, easy-to-use, free tool, Telegram is your choice for sure!

reviews.title: Secure Messaging Application.
reviews.pros:
- It is a feature-packed messaging application for both pc and smartphones.

- Telegram allows the user to create groups with up to 200,000 members.

- Bots can be deployed by the group admin to automate tasks within groups.

- It has a global search to search anything across the telegram platform.

- It is a security-oriented messaging application that allows its users to stay anonymous in groups or from other users on the platform.
reviews.cons: - It is a bit overwhelming to use initially because of the number of features available.
reviews.overall: Overall, Telegram can be used as a primary messaging application by anyone because its features target every age group. The user data is very secure on this platform.

reviews.title: Fully Loaded Messaging App
reviews.pros: Due to the spam-free policy of Telegram, it is widely used for purposes such as trafficking and many more. It is not as popular as WhatsApp due to its marketing. Due to its feature of handling a lot of participants at once, It's widely used for its educational channels. Also, it has a huge cloud storage.
reviews.cons: Telegram is an Indian app. It's similar to WhatsApp, but you can share large files very easily on telegram. You can make large groups and channels on telegram. It's advantageous to share class notes and other educational purposes. It can keep u updated with daily news as there's a lot of good news channels on it. You can download movies, videos and many more things on telegram.
reviews.overall: It's a great app for educational purposes and to store data and to make large groups and channels, but also due to its two-layer and spam-free privacy, many illegal processes take place. It has better privacy as it doesn't share your number with strangers. The groups are spam-free on Telegram.

reviews.title: A very good application for meeting new people and secure chatting.
reviews.pros:
Well there are many pros  of this application like:

- You can meet people who will change your perspective about life, future business partner, your new friend, etc.

- It provides a very secure chatting process.

- You can hide your profile and you can create your own group or super group.

- Telegram has more features than other messenger applications.

- Telegram can work on several devices at the same time and you can transfer files from one device to another as well.
reviews.cons:
There are a few cons of this application as well:

- Telegram is not an easy platform, subscribers can leave your channel or group as quickly as they come because of the vast platform it provides to others as well.

- Your Telegram can be flooded with messages most of the time.

- Should focus on the appearance of this platform, this is a very bad thing about this application that it does not have an attractive interface which can be a very huge problem for its popularity among people.
reviews.overall:
Overall Telegram is a revolutionary application for chatting securely and masking new friends and colleagues.

Should definitely focus  on making its Interface more attractive to get it more popular.

reviews.title: Pros and Cons of Telegram.
reviews.pros:
- No Ads and completely free.

- End to end encrypted.

- Ordinary and secret chats.

- Simple and easy interface to use.
reviews.cons:
- No multiple selections.

- Can’t easily figure out the opposite person is online or offline.

- Pirated contents can be easily shared.
reviews.overall:
Its a good alternative for WhatsApp as it is a simple and easy to use app.

It's a secure app.

User Friendly App.

reviews.title: A decent whatsapp alternative finally
reviews.pros:
- The best pro for me is the independent phone and desktop apps. This prevents the annoying delays and connectivity errors that we face in WhatsApp. 

- The self destructing secret chat is also an interesting feature.
reviews.cons: There is nothing much not to like about telegram except the fact that not enough people are on it at the moment.
reviews.overall: I have always found WhatsApp to be limiting in several ways. Telegram has solved a lot of those issues.

reviews.title: The big brother of whatsapp.
reviews.pros: - Telegram has at least one small improvement over every little feature that WhatsApp has. Its desktop app also works independently of the phone!
reviews.cons: - The only problem with Telegram is that the rest of the world is on WhatsApp.
reviews.overall: I think WhatsApp has several minor issues that annoy us from time to time. Telegram is a good upgrade for the same.

reviews.title: Better than other messaging tools
reviews.pros: It offers great large files sharing feature gives a great option for the project team to share remotely. Bot command to make channel automated. It has multi-platform support.
reviews.cons: It lacks video and audio calling features and the rest of the features are great.
reviews.overall: Telegram is a very handy messaging tool. It offers great support of the group channels with the bot commands to makes channel automated. It also offers announcements and message pin option to share the latest updates.

reviews.title: Rules over other messaging apps!!
reviews.pros:
- Offers great freedom of transferring larger files.

- End-to-end encrypted for secure conversations.

- Very lightweight and easy to use.

- Very customisable.
reviews.cons:
- No encryption in desktop version.

- No online payment option while other competitors provide this feature.
reviews.overall: Very good messaging app with loads of features provided. Downloading films and TV shows are even easier with Telegram app. Secret chats is a very useful feature when it comes to very private conversations.

reviews.title: Excellent messaging app with desirable features
reviews.pros:
▪︎It allows you to send files with size up to 1.5 GB, which is excellent. 

▪︎I love their sleek UI and interface. 

▪︎Huge number of channels to discover like-minded people based on your interests is a unique feature of the app. 

▪︎They have a fun assortment of stickers. 

▪︎The secret chats feature that lets you set timer for self-destructing messages is a very good addition. 

▪︎Gives great importance to security.

▪︎Cross-platform.

▪︎Free.
reviews.cons:
▪︎Does not allow video-calling.

▪︎Doesn't have as many users as most other social networking and messaging apps.
reviews.overall: Telegram has proven to be a great messaging app with emphasis on security and building a community. It is also a good platform to share files and media that are large in size. It is also free.

reviews.title: Instant messaging makes it perfect with project management
reviews.pros:
Its very easy to share large files and documents.

Creating channels and groups makes it convenient with team collaboration.

It's free to download and install.

More intuitive user interface.
reviews.cons: For now I have no challenge while using the software.
reviews.overall:
Yes its incredible with instant messaging which ensure faster feedback.

User friendly interface with intuitive user interface.

It's free to register with phone number for any country.

reviews.title: The most secure IM client.
reviews.pros:
UI feels lightweight and non cumbersome. 

Has multiple clients for Desktop and Mobile devices. 

Has dark mode even on the desktop client. 

Very secure.
reviews.cons:
Needs to have video calling feature, instead of people nearby. 

Doesn't work on Jailbroken devices.
reviews.overall: It's a great client that needs new and innovative features to attract a larger user base. It's the most secure instant messaging application on the app stores.

reviews.title: Decent alternative to FB Messenger
reviews.pros:
Supports stickers, Giphy, group chats, and importing contacts from phone directory.

Works on a variety of platforms, even the browser sidebar of Opera Developer.
reviews.cons: The value of a social network app is based on how many people use it, and Telegram doesn't have nearly as many users as some of the other alternatives.
reviews.overall: I've been using Telegram off and on for about half a year now, more so after deactivating Facebook. It's slightly less addicting to check Telegram vs Messenger, in part because you don't get a red super obvious indicator when messages come in.

reviews.title: Telegram a great way to communicate
reviews.pros:
(+) Easy to use and the interface is quite user friendly.

(+) Channel option, one can add unlimited number of people to a channel.

(+) Different media type files can be shared, large files can also be shared.

(+) Free of cost.
reviews.cons:
(-) The interface looks a bit old, can be modernized.

(-) Notification if someone from my contact list joined on telegram.

(-) A lot of spam and fake content.

(-) Holds a lot of pirated books and movies.
reviews.overall:
I have been using Telegram for almost 4 years now. There are a lot of channels which provide a lot of information for free. One can get a lot of information on public exams, news, articles, and a lot of guidance for many other useful things.

On the negative side Telegram holds a lot of pirated content. There is no moderation on the content that is being held on telegram. I have also seen some fraudulent activities taking place in Telegram. It would be great to see some sort of rules and regulations in place.

reviews.title: The Most Secure Messaging app
reviews.pros:
Fast & Lightweight.

Very intuitive & easy to use.

Message deletion feature.

Cross-Platform.

Secure.

Share large files up to 1.5 GB.
reviews.cons:
No video calling feature.

Spam filter needs improvement.
reviews.overall: Telegram is one of the most complete and secure messaging app. Despite facing tough competition, it is popular as a messaging app for any confidential communication.

reviews.title: Modern way of communication
reviews.pros: Telegram lets me send any type of media and files. App available on mobile and laptop so no compatibility problem. Telegram has many bot command features to makes messaging very handy. It has an appealing user interface.
reviews.cons: Telegram doesn't support video calling feature which is its drawback.
reviews.overall: Telegram is modern way of messaging which gives me ability to send any size and types of media and files. It supports many bot commands which makes my channel innovative. Messages are very secure thanks to its encryptions engine.

reviews.title: Helps in reaching out to large group of people
reviews.pros: I am using telegram from the last 2 years, It compensates for the shortcomings of WhatsApp. We can add a large number of people in a group which is not possible in other applications. The UI is very simple and easy to understand.  The voice calling works perfectly with good voice quality, It works even if the Internet connection is not that strong.
reviews.cons: The security is not that strong with the bots in the market our data can be easily be manipulated. The application does not have a video calling option that needs to be added.
reviews.overall: The application is best if you want to be a part of large group where people share useful material and messages with each other. For short and quick conversations WhatsApp is still the best option.

reviews.title: Easy to use
reviews.pros: Super easy way to use and set up messaging from multiple devices and can be accessed from anywhere.
reviews.cons: There aren't any cons that i dislike about it so far.
reviews.overall: Overall it's a good tool and works well. It's reliable which is another important aspect of it for me.

reviews.title: WhatsApp's Number one Competitor
reviews.pros:
1) Groups don't have limit.

2) Channels are not same as broadcast lists in WhatsApp with no limit.

3) Secure with end to end protection.

4) Bots which refine work and help in super productivity.

5)No limit on file download and upload.

6) You can chat with a person without letting him know your phone number.

7) Media cloud storage.
reviews.cons: Telegram is growing community and evolving at super pace, the spam and other illicit content is increasing too, moderation is good but still feel it needs a better management in terms of keeping the platform clean.
reviews.overall:
We have been using telegram since a long time, initially used this as an alternate to google drive mobile to quick send file but have later evolved its usage as a personal assistant for all needs.  

A file uploader, a notes taker, a doodler and what not, Telegram is evolving at a rapid phase with many of its new and interesting features.
